items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 21 at 3:12PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
A strong Bering Sea system will bring moderate to heavy rain at
times along the coast as well as gusty winds and rough seas along
the coast waters of Northern Bristol Bay. A southerly push of
winds up Nushagak Bay Wednesday morning may bring increased water-
levels up the Bay but coastal flooding is of little to no concern
due to lower tides.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued July 21 at 1:31PM AKDT until July 23 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...The following areas, Susitna Valley and Hatcher Pass. This
includes the cities of Skwentna, Willow, Talkeetna, Trapper Creek,
Petersville, and Chulitna.

* WHEN...Through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Low-water
crossings may be flooded. Area rivers, creeks, and s
items.areas: Hatcher Pass; Western Susitna Valley; Southern Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley; Northern Susitna Valley
items.instruction:

to take action should flooding develop.
